title: STN non-production backend design/test control contract

boundary.external_integrations: disabled by default; any sandbox integration must be separately allow-listed and use synthetic data only

authentication.model: test identity-provider integration contract; this repository contains no live identity provider, user directory, credential, or token
authentication.mfa_requirement: required before any future non-synthetic environment; not implemented by this design-only harness
session_controls: revocation behaviour must be tested before any environment promotion

audit.persistence_design: append-only audit-event store with tamper-evident sequencing required before promotion
audit.payload_policy: no assessment wording, response values, identifiers, credentials, or free-text notes in routine audit metadata
audit.read_access: auditor role only; separated from ordinary assessor access
audit.retention_and_export: not implemented; requires approved privacy/records policy

encryption.required_in_transit: TLS 1.2 or later for every deployed test endpoint
encryption.required_at_rest: encrypted test datastore and encrypted backups when persistence is introduced
encryption.key_management: environment-managed test keys outside source control; no keystores, private keys, passwords, or cloud secrets in this repository
encryption.rotation_and_recovery: design and test required before promotion
encryption.client_storage_note: Flutter local encryption is not a replacement for backend identity, authorization, auditing, key management, or records governance

privacy.minimization: only synthetic identifiers and fixture data are permitted
privacy.logging: redacted structured logs only; do not log source responses, free text, tokens, secrets, IP addresses, or identifiers
privacy.backup: synthetic-only test backups; no production retention schedule is implied
privacy.access_and_correction: not implemented; requires future privacy and operating procedure approval

safety.safety_tag_handling: a tagged synthetic response may create a non-clinical human-review-required state only; it must not be treated as a safety clearance or live escalation
safety.production_safety_workflow: not implemented; requires approved operational ownership, acknowledgement, timeout, fallback, after-hours coverage, and drill evidence

source_traceability.allowed_client_scope: existing 25-item Flutter Part A mapping only

promotion_gates: independent clinical approval for exact content, intended use, and safety process
completed privacy impact assessment and records governance
threat model, penetration test, security review, and remediation evidence
implemented identity, MFA, server-side authorization, tenant isolation, audit persistence, encryption, backup and recovery
human safety escalation operating procedure, ownership, drills, and signed release decision for an exact build
